title: An off day: one light rest-day text, no push
origin: Spec #6 (nudge scheduler), Watch: an off day

history.text: Plan's yours, Jordan. I'll hold you to it. You in?
Enjoy the weekend. Rest day tomorrow, back at it Tuesday 🏃

plan.reason: Four runs a week builds the base without wrecking your legs.

whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: a rest day.
shouldHaveHappened: One morning text ZOH starts itself: short and light, uses Jordan's name, says today is a rest day and the next run is tomorrow (Tuesday). No push, no check-in, no follow-up later. "nice, legs needed it" gets a short, warm reply that doesn't push today's step (there isn't one). Nothing else that day.
